items.title: Beyond the copilot: Why financial institutions need governed AI on AgentCore
items.summary: For complex, regulated workloads, the question is not whether to use AI but who owns the governance controls and whether you can prove it. This post explains why business-critical financial services workloads need institutions to own their governance controls, and how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore provides a governed foundation for regulated decisions.
items.creator: Roshan Rao
